observations: The bounded MassGIS parcel query returned 49 neighboring parcel features; the selected garden parcel union must be chosen and then used to clip every context layer.
The bounded MassGIS Building Structures query returned 73 roofprints from the garden and neighboring properties.
The bounded MassGIS-MassDOT Roads query returned 20 road segments, principally public-road context rather than interior walks.
The bounded 2016 land-cover query returned 837 polygons across thirteen cover classes. This is useful historical/coarse evidence, not current bed geometry.

The bounded OSM query returned 93 mapped elements, including a garden polygon, buildings, public roads, and some service drives, but no complete internal bed, plant, path, parking, fence, or utility inventory.

The OSM garden polygon cites an older MassGIS OpenSpace import. The current 2026 MassGIS OpenSpace query returned no Berkshire Botanical Garden feature in this bbox, so that OSM polygon must not replace the current four-parcel MassGIS boundary.
remainingAcquisition: Use current MassGIS parcels for the site skeleton and clip all other source snapshots to the selected parcel union.
Use current MassGIS roofprints before tracing structures from imagery.
Use 2025 orthophotos and the user-supplied georeferenced KMZ for internal drive, parking, path, plot, bed, and initial plant geometry.
Verify beds and plants by field observation or a higher-resolution garden inventory; neither statewide MassGIS nor current OSM supplies those semantics completely.
No statewide public source found here provides local telephone/electric poles, fences, or irrigation assets comprehensively. OSM can supplement them only where contributors have mapped them.
